title: Wire Python marketing runtime to new signups (event-driven: DynamoDB stream → Lambda → evaluate_rules/outbound_email)
description: Wire the Python marketing runtime (services/marketing-runtime) to new signups so that actions (e.g. welcome email, rule evaluation) run automatically. Prefer event-driven: DynamoDB stream on WaitlistSignup and/or MarketingEnrollment → Lambda → Python (evaluate_rules, outbound_email). See features/marketing_automation.feature and docs/marketing-automation.md.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter
